meta.model: Holt-Winters Multiplicative Exponential Smoothing + Additive Trend + Damped Trend (phi=0.98) + Weekly Seasonality (s=7) + Nataru Calendar Shock
meta.training_dataset: Gabungan Runtun Waktu Kontinu 2025 (365 hari) + 2026 (272 hari) = 637 Hari
meta.scenario_note: Scenario factor adalah asumsi proyeksi kebijakan/animo, bukan parameter internal Holt-Winters: moderat=1.00, optimis=1.07, konservatif=0.95.
meta.ci_method: RMSE-based approximate 95% interval / uncertainty approximation (CI = ŷ ± 1.96 × RMSE)
